visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two side-by-side promo panels, each with heading, optional subheading, text and CTA buttons; a panel may have a background image

sources.style: Left panel navy rgb(16,21,56) with background photo and white text; right panel light grey rgb(245,246,248) with dark text; green rgb(0,131,85) primary buttons.
sources.stylingNotes: Two side-by-side promo panels: left dark navy panel with faint photo background ('Get better fast.' + paragraph + Learn More button); right light grey panel ('My Health at Vanderbilt' + paragraph + green Sign in button + outline Create New Account button).

sources.style: Left panel white, right panel beige rgb(242,238,228); dark text; green buttons.
sources.stylingNotes: Two side-by-side promo panels: left white panel ('Volunteer with Us', H3 subheading, paragraph, green Learn More); right beige panel ('ResearchMatch', H3 subheading, two paragraphs, green English button and outline Spanish button).

contentPattern.structure: one row; each cell is a panel: optional background image first, then H2, optional H3, paragraph(s), CTA link(s)
contentPattern.description: Two side-by-side panels each with H2, paragraph and CTA buttons | Two side-by-side panels each with H2, H3, paragraph(s) and CTA buttons

usage: Paired promotional panels (e.g. Get better fast / My Health at Vanderbilt, Volunteer / ResearchMatch).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any 2-up panel pair with headings and CTAs; use plain columns for text+image layouts.
